checks.name: exact ordinal prefix and path aliases
typed integer rejects bool and negative
exact blob and exact whole LF->CRLF only
mixed original CR and NUL do not normalize
full metadata/S/H partition and distinct historical checkout bytes
missing S and history alias rejected
wrong Git OID/domain and false historical SHA claim rejected
unchanged 256MiB aggregate enforced without payload allocation
raw NUL Git tree regular-only/truncation checks
baseline exact buildstd placement/no metadata fmt leakage
CI failure can never become static PASS

scope: Pure synthetic Python models only. No official artifact, CI, compiler, PE execution, Windows, remote or repository mutation.
